title: ظلال فوق الميناء
description: تطلب نورا بليك من ليو جمع دليل يربط الإشارة الغامضة بشحنة وصلت إلى الميناء.
cinematic_beats: Rain falls on harbor containers as a distant ship horn sounds.
Nora slides a photograph across a dimly lit table.
The camera holds on a container number before control returns to the player.

objectives.description: قابل نورا في المقهى القريب من الميناء
ادخل منطقة الميناء دون لفت الانتباه

player_choices.description: شارك كل الأدلة أو احتفظ بجزء منها؛ تتغير ثقة نورا والنتائج اللاحقة.

design_notes: Playable lightweight blockout in scripts/missions/mission_003_runtime.gd. Unlocks after mission_002 completion. Includes contact meeting, harbor gate, three collectible evidence markers, three moving placeholder guards, a 100-degree forward field of view, a 3.2-meter detection radius, physics-ray line-of-sight checks against collision layer 1, a three-alert failure limit, retry, return-to-contact completion, and a local completion save. Container collision can block guard sight when the ray intersects it. Still a prototype: no advanced guard navigation, sound propagation, disguises, takedowns, final harbor assets, voice acting, or Android device testing.

runtime_config.line_of_sight: Physics ray from guard eye height to player; collision layer 1 blockers hide the player
